text:
Maya C: quick ping — opened a tiny PR that changes auth header handling for onprem sidecar. want a fast privacy/security sanity check before i merge.
Maya C: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821 (small diff)
Maya C: main concern is we stop shipping a deprecated env var and rely on token-projection; does that widen any secret surface?
Ravi P: taking a look now. can you paste the diff snippet for the header change? easier than opening full PR for quick scan.
Maya C: sure, copied inline:
Maya C: ```diff
- const AUTH = process.env.OLD_AUTH_HEADER || req.headers['x-auth']
+ const AUTH = req.headers['x-inference-auth'] || tokenProjection.get(req)
``` 
Ravi P: ok. two quick checks: 1) tokenProjection.get(req) — confirm it never falls back to envs, 2) is x-inference-auth logged anywhere before redaction?
Maya C: tokenProjection impl: we read from proxied header or exchange with local agent; no env fallback. not logged by our middleware, only after auth middleware sets ctx.user (we redact logs normally).
Jess L: ran a quick grep + secret-scan on the branch. secret-scan flagged no new hardcoded secrets. grep: no use of OLD_AUTH_HEADER elsewhere.
Jess L: one doc ask: update private-deploy.md to note the header rename and the migration step for onprem customers.
Theo R: small thing — for VPC/onprem customers, removing the env var could break older sidecar setups during a rolling deploy. can we add a canary rollout plan and a 24h hold? :eyes:
Maya C: planned to do a canary. proposed timeline: canary -> 2 nodes (hour) -> 25% -> 50% -> full, with fallback to previous Docker tag. happy to hold if sec asks.
Ravi P: also add a quick e2e smoke that asserts tokenProjection returns nil when header missing (so we don't accidentally return a placeholder). throw a unit test too.
Maya C: will add test and doc. thanks.
deploy-bot: CI passed — unit: 48/48, e2e: 12/12, secret-scan: clean
Theo R: lgtm from me pending the docs + test. request: @Jess L please confirm the log-redaction rule covers the new header key.
Jess L: confirmed. logging middleware redacts keys matching `/x-.*-auth/` so `x-inference-auth` is covered.
Ravi P: i can give formal approval after test + migration doc. if you push those i'll approve and we can merge in the next slot (today afternoon deploy window).
Maya C: will push changes in ~30m. holding merge until approvals + will tag rollout in the PR description. thanks everyone. :slightly_smiling_face:
